title: Be reliable without becoming permanently available
method: A conceptual sequence for the reflection exercise in this essay. The steps describe a possible practice, not a measured causal effect or a universal rule.
alt: Concept diagram: Name the request types — Separate routine questions, planned reviews, and incidents.; Set a response promise — Make timing and required context explicit.; Provide a fallback — Give urgent work and absences a dependable route.; Honor and adjust — Meet the commitment or communicate the change..
